lines.text: Pia flips a coin before each move. Heads, one step. Tails, two.
lines.caption: Pia flips a coin before each move. Heads, one step. Tails, two.

lines.text: Will she land on step five?
lines.caption: Will she land on step five?

lines.text: Heads, she goes up one step. Tails, up two.
lines.caption: Heads, she goes up one step. Tails, up two.

lines.text: What's the chance she stands on step five?
lines.caption: What's the chance she stands on step five?

lines.text: Work up the stairs! She comes from one step below with heads, or two below with tails.
lines.caption: Work up the stairs! She comes from one step below with heads, or two below with tails.

lines.text: Each move is a coin flip, so average those two chances.
lines.caption: Each move is a coin flip, so average those two chances.

lines.text: The ground is one. Then one half, three fourths, five eighths, eleven sixteenths.
lines.caption: The ground is one. Then one half, three fourths, five eighths, eleven sixteenths.

lines.text: Average eleven sixteenths and five eighths. That's twenty-one thirty-seconds!
lines.caption: Average eleven sixteenths and five eighths. That's twenty-one thirty-seconds!

lines.text: She lands on it more than half the time!
lines.caption: She lands on it more than half the time!

lines.text: Why is it not one half? The full lesson lists every way, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why is it not one half? The full lesson lists every way, plus every trap.
